'''Argon''' was an elemental [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that existed in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of [[Genarius]] and [[Brath Qella]] and was breathed by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].

Argon in the atmosphere was critical to the health of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. [[Atmosphere generator]]s on Verpine colony [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] produced argon as part of its atmospheric mixture.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
